system.description:
Hairfoot Halfling

Hairfoot halflings are the most common and best-known of the three halfling subraces. They are what most people picture when they think of halflings: plump, cheerful, comfort-loving creatures with large, heavily-furred feet that give the subrace its name. They dwell in cozy burrow-holes in rolling hills and farmlands, maintaining large vegetable gardens and enjoying an almost obsessive love of food, pipe-weed, and good company. Hairfoots are least likely of the halfling subraces to go adventuring, though many do find themselves reluctantly drawn into greater events. This subrace corresponds to the standard halfling of the Player's Handbook.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Strength: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 30 feet.
  • Missile Attack Bonus: +3 to attack rolls with slings and all thrown weapons.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +4 to all saving throws vs. magic spells, wand effects, and staves.
  • Detect Grade/Slope and New Construction: On a roll of 1–3 on a d6 in underground settings.
  • Detect Unsafe Stonework: On a roll of 1–2 on a d6.
  • Move Silently: Hairfoot halflings move with near-complete silence outdoors and in natural terrain. They surprise opponents on 1–4 on a d6 when outdoors.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC vs. ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Thief multiclass.
system.source: The Complete Book of Gnomes & Halflings
